description: Pareto distribution cumulative distribution function 1 - (x_m/x)^alpha (shape alpha, scale x_m)

tolerance.reason: x, alpha and x_m are exact doubles and x_m is a power of two, so x/x_m is exact (where it is a double; otherwise log x - log x_m is within an ulp of log(x/x_m) relative, as no cancellation occurs there) and x/x_m - 1 is exact for x/x_m <= 2; t = alpha log1p(x/x_m - 1) is then within a few ulps, and -expm1(-t) adds an ulp. The condition number in t, t / (e^t - 1), is at most 1, so a careful method loses a few ulps at most. 1e-13 as for the other functions; results below 2.2e-308 are judged relative to that number (conventions)

grid: shape alpha in {2^-5, 0.1, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3.5, 10, 100} x scale x_m = 2^m for m in {-500, -10, 0, 10, 500} x x = u x_m for u in {1, 1 + 2^-52, 1 + 1e-15, 1 + 1e-10, 1 + 1e-5, 1.001, 1.1, 1.5, 2, 5, 10, 100, 1e5, 1e10, 1e20, 1e50, 1e100, 1e200, 1e300, 1.1 2^1030, 1.1 2^1060, 2^1100, 2^1500}, kept where x is normal and finite (so x/x_m = u exactly as a real number), plus x = x_m (1 - 2^-53), x_m/2, 0 and -x_m below the support; F is 0 for x < x_m and rounds to 1 above about t = 37.4 with t = alpha log(x/x_m)
